newsitem.title: USA: U.S. DEBT FUTURES MIXED, SEPT T-BOND WAFFLES.
newsitem.headline: U.S. DEBT FUTURES MIXED, SEPT T-BOND WAFFLES.

text.p: Aug 6 - U.S. debt futures were mixed after 10-year note auction results and the Fed's beige book. Sept T-bond cut gains post-auction, then waffled on both sides of Tuesday's close after the report. Fed says U.S. economy grew moderately in June/July, growth in some areas more brisk. U.S labor market tightened, but only scattered wage pressure.
